{{Navbar-Global_Coal_Plant_Tracker}}
'''Shanxi Yuguang power station''' (山西山阴煤矸石发电) is an operating power station of at least 1300-megawatts (MW) in Beizhouzhuang, Shanyin, Shuozhou, Shanxi, China.
It is also known as Shanxi Shanyin power station, 昱光（山阴）煤矸石综合利用发电项目二期 (Phase II Unit 3, Phase II Unit 4), 昱光（山阴）煤矸石综合利用发电项目一期 (Phase I Unit 1, Phase I Unit 2).

==Background on Project==

[[Shanxi International Electricity Group]] and [[ChinaCoal]] are currently planning to build a four-unit coal-fired power plant with a total planned capacity of 1,300 MW in Shanxi Province. The first two units began operating in 2012.<ref>[http://bit.ly/1rOZdwt "昱光发电厂2号机组通过168小时试运行"], 中国能源建设集团有限公司, 2012-5-29</ref><ref>[http://bit.ly/1pcegih "4火电项目获环保部环评公示"], 中国能源报人民网, 2012-05-14</ref><ref>[http://bit.ly/1wjOW2r " 企业简介"], 山西昱光发电有限责任公司</ref>

==Expansion==

Two more units of 350 MW each have been permitted.<ref>[http://bit.ly/1rYoA4Z "我院签订山西昱光发电有限公司二期2×350MW工程EPC总承包合同"], 西北电力设计院, 2014-05-29</ref><ref>[http://zgdlhg.com/xwzx/201507233079.html "山西省环境保护厅批复四个火电项目,"] 2015-07-23</ref><ref>[http://www.zmsxhy.com/n47/n84/c47508/content.html "中煤华昱昱光发电厂,"] China Coal, 2014-03-16</ref> 

They were reported as under construction in November 2015, and planned for operation in 2017.<ref>[http://epaper.sxrb.com/shtml/sxrb/20151116/294192.shtml "李小鹏在朔州忻州调研时强调：深入贯彻落实五中全会精神努力实现经济社会全面发展,"] Nov 11, 2015</ref>

Unit 4 was commissioned on June 6, 2019.<ref>[http://news.bjx.com.cn/html/20190606/984692.shtml "昱光电厂#4机组顺利通过168小时试运行,"] 北极星电力网新闻中心, 2019/6/6</ref> Unit 3 was commissioned on June 17, 2019.<ref>[http://news.bjx.com.cn/html/20190617/986482.shtml "山阴电厂二期项目3号机组通过168小时试运行,"] 北极星电力网新闻中心, 2019/6/17</ref>
